items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: I was under the direction of Dewey Jackson at the time.

ctx.x: Which boat was at the capital?

It was the capital then, it was the capital. And I worked and we signed up, I went out of St. Louis, we had a real good band. I was under the direction of Dewey Jackson at the time. So Dewey I don't think came back, no he didn't come back I don't think. So fate took over the band. So I signed up again, every season we signed St. Louis for this, winter season, signed here for the summer. That's how we used to do it, two contracts a year.
Was it the other way around, summer up there?
